title: Minimum Number of Steps to Make Two Strings Anagram
summary: Given two strings of equal length, s and t, determine the least number of character replacements needed in t to transform it into an anagram of s.
statement: Given two strings of equal length, s and t, determine the least number of character replacements needed in t to transform it into an anagram of s. An anagram shares the same characters as the original string but in a different order.
constraints: Strings have equal length and lowercase letters.
Replace characters in t so it becomes an anagram of s.
hints: Each missing occurrence required by s must replace one surplus occurrence in t.
Equal total lengths guarantee deficits and surpluses have the same total.
editorial: Equal total lengths guarantee deficits and surpluses have the same total.

tests.explanation: t lacks one b and has one extra a, so one replacement suffices.
The frequency deficits determine the minimum replacements.
